overview.title: Northwind API
overview.description: A sample API for a fictional wholesale company.
overview.markdown:
A sample API for a fictional wholesale company. It's here so you can see how a guide shows an API reference: replace it with your own OpenAPI file in Settings › API reference.

- **Version:** `1.0.0`
- **OpenAPI:** 3.1.0

## Base URL

- `https://api.northwind.example/v1`: Production
- `https://sandbox.northwind.example/v1`: Sandbox

## Authentication

Endpoints take one of these, unless a page says otherwise:

- **bearerAuth:** Bearer token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A token from your Northwind dashboard.
- **apiKey:** An API key in the `X-API-Key` header. For server-to-server calls.

## Endpoints

### Products

What Northwind sells.

- [List products](/api-reference/products/list-products): `GET /products`
- [Get a product](/api-reference/products/get-a-product): `GET /products/{productId}`

### Orders

Orders customers place.

- [List orders](/api-reference/orders/list-orders): `GET /orders`
- [Create an order](/api-reference/orders/create-an-order): `POST /orders`
- [Get an order](/api-reference/orders/get-an-order): `GET /orders/{orderId}`
- [Cancel an order](/api-reference/orders/cancel-an-order): `DELETE /orders/{orderId}`

### Customers

The companies that buy from Northwind.

- [Get a customer](/api-reference/customers/get-a-customer): `GET /customers/{customerId}`

pages./api-reference/products/list-products:
`GET https://api.northwind.example/v1/products`

Returns products, sorted by name. Anyone can list products: no credentials needed.

- **Authentication:** None.

## Query parameters

- `category` ("beverages" | "condiments" | "produce" | "seafood"): Only products in this category.
- `limit` (integer): How many to return. From 1 to 100. Default `20`.

## Responses

- `200`: A page of products.
  - `data` (array of object)
    - `id` (string)
    - `name` (string)
    - `category` (string)
    - `unit_price` (number): In US dollars.
    - `in_stock` (integer)
  - `has_more` (boolean)

## Examples

::::tabs{sync="lang"}
:::tab[curl]
```bash
curl https://api.northwind.example/v1/products
```
:::
:::tab[JavaScript]
```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://api.northwind.example/v1/products");
const data = await res.json();
```
:::
:::tab[Python]
```python
import requests

r = requests.get("https://api.northwind.example/v1/products")
r.raise_for_status()
print(r.json())
```
:::

pages./api-reference/products/get-a-product:
`GET https://api.northwind.example/v1/products/{productId}`

Returns one product.

- **Authentication:** None.

## Path parameters

- `productId` (string, required): The product's ID.

## Responses

- `200`: The product.
  - `id` (string)
  - `name` (string)
  - `category` (string)
  - `unit_price` (number): In US dollars.
  - `in_stock` (integer)
- `404`: Nothing has that ID.

pages./api-reference/orders/list-orders:
`GET https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders`

Returns your orders, newest first.

- **Authentication:** Bearer token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Or: An API key in the `X-API-Key` header.

## Query parameters

- `status` ("pending" | "shipped" | "cancelled"): Only orders with this status.

## Responses

- `200`: Your orders.
  - `data` (array of object)
    - `id` (string)
    - `customer_id` (string)
    - `status` ("pending" | "shipped" | "cancelled")
    - `lines` (array of object)
    - `total` (number): In US dollars.
    - `created_at` (string (date-time)): ISO 8601, for example `2026-11-30T12:00:00Z`.
- `401`: The token or API key is missing or wrong.

## Examples

::::tabs{sync="lang"}
:::tab[curl]
```bash
curl https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN"
```
:::
:::tab[JavaScript]
```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders", {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.API_TOKEN}`,
  },
});
const data = await res.json();
```
:::
:::tab[Python]
```python
import os

import requests

r = requests.get(
    "https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['API_TOKEN']}"},
)
r.raise_for_status()
print(r.json())
```
:::

pages./api-reference/orders/create-an-order:
`POST https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders`

Places an order for one customer. Stock is reserved until the order ships or is cancelled.

- **Authentication:** Bearer token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Or: An API key in the `X-API-Key` header.

## Request body

`application/json`, required.

- `customer_id` (string, required): Who the order is for.
- `lines` (array of object, required)
  - `product_id` (string, required)
  - `quantity` (integer, required): At least 1.
- `ship_by` (string (date)): The latest shipping date the customer accepts.

## Responses

- `201`: The order was placed.
  - `id` (string)
  - `customer_id` (string)
  - `status` ("pending" | "shipped" | "cancelled")
  - `lines` (array of object)
    - `product_id` (string)
    - `quantity` (integer): At least 1.
  - `total` (number): In US dollars.
  - `created_at` (string (date-time)): ISO 8601, for example `2026-11-30T12:00:00Z`.
- `401`: The token or API key is missing or wrong.
- `422`: A product is out of stock, or the customer doesn't exist.

## Examples

::::tabs{sync="lang"}
:::tab[curl]
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
       "customer_id": "cus_ALFKI",
       "lines": [
         {
           "product_id": "prd_chai",
           "quantity": 12
         }
       ]
     }'
```
:::
:::tab[JavaScript]
```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.API_TOKEN}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "customer_id": "cus_ALFKI",
    "lines": [
      {
        "product_id": "prd_chai",
        "quantity": 12
      }
    ]
  }),
});
const data = await res.json();
```
:::
:::tab[Python]
```python
import os

import requests

r = requests.post(
    "https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['API_TOKEN']}"},
    json={
        "customer_id": "cus_ALFKI",
        "lines": [{"product_id": "prd_chai", "quantity": 12}],
    },
)
r.raise_for_status()
print(r.json())
```
:::

pages./api-reference/orders/cancel-an-order:
`DELETE https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders/{orderId}`

Cancels an order that hasn't shipped. Its stock goes back on sale.

- **Authentication:** Bearer token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Or: An API key in the `X-API-Key` header.

## Path parameters

- `orderId` (string, required): The order's ID.

## Responses

- `204`: The order was cancelled.
- `409`: The order has already shipped.

## Examples

::::tabs{sync="lang"}
:::tab[curl]
```bash
curl -X DELETE https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders/ord_10248 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN"
```
:::
:::tab[JavaScript]
```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders/ord_10248", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.API_TOKEN}`,
  },
});
if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${res.status}`);
```
:::
:::tab[Python]
```python
import os

import requests

r = requests.delete(
    "https://api.northwind.example/v1/orders/ord_10248",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['API_TOKEN']}"},
)
r.raise_for_status()
```
:::
